units.reason: New end-to-end test adapted from the stale-series test; test files cannot affect production behavior.
units.headline: New test: selected-series block not merged with non-selected block
units.summary: Adds a regression test that tags an on-disk block with the from-selected-series hint, runs block compaction and reload, and asserts inOrderBlocksMaxTime stays below a WAL-only sample at t=700 and that the sample survives. It is the from-stale-series test with the hint swapped, so it adds coverage without changing runtime code; a line-by-line review is not needed.

issues.title: Doc comment says test fails on current implementation, but PR fixes it
issues.failure_scenario: On this branch CompactBlockMetas now calls res.Compaction.SetSelectedSeries() and inOrderBlocksMaxTime skips FromSelectedSeries blocks, so the test passes; the comment misleads readers into thinking it is a known-failing repro.
issues.detail: The comment describes a pre-fix state as current, which is stale once the fix in this same PR lands.

units.reason: Test body moved verbatim from elsewhere in db_test.go with only a provenance comment added; no assertions changed.
units.headline: Stale-block merge test moved, provenance comment added
units.summary: The existing TestStaleBlockNotMergedWithNonStaleBlock is moved later in the file unchanged, with a comment noting it was copied from PR #19016. Assertions and setup are identical to the removed copy, so test coverage and production behavior are unchanged.
